evals.name: basic-swarm-with-memory
evals.prompt: Design a hierarchical swarm for a customer service content factory with full memory ecosystem (checkpoints, decisions, sessions, INDEX) from day one, using Ruflo and content-forge principles. Extract relevant P/PT from knowledge-pack.
evals.expected_output: Full topology, 10+ agents with 7 files each, memory/ structure with INDEX updated, PLAN-v2, traceability to sources, no context stuffing, Research-Plan-Reset documented.

evals.name: meta-transform-knowledge-pack
evals.prompt: Use the content-forge swarm and Ruflo principles to transform the raw knowledge-pack/ (or the skill-planning-knowledge-pack) into the Master Architecture skill itself, with >20 agents one-by-one, memory fin da subito.
evals.expected_output: The skill dir with kernel, agents/ (25+), memory/, scripts/, references/knowledge-pack/, evals, packaged. Multiple PLAN-vN. All principles extracted and applied. Memory updated live during build.

evals.name: full-ecosystem-with-ruflo-integration
evals.prompt: Architect a complete Master Architecture for an AION-like studio: raw UGC brief → multi-agent swarm (Ruflo) with memory (screenshot style + two-layer) → video/image gen workflows (Content-Forge pipeline) → self-improving. Include all 15 principles + extracts from Ruflo/Content-Forge/Advisor/Skill-Creator.
evals.expected_output: MKD, 6 PLAN-vN, 25+ agents specs (7 files), memory/ with 10+ CPs/DECs/SES, topology map, Context Manifests, Ruflo swarm init commands, Python memory tools, evals, failure-modes-log, traceability 100%, no AP01/AP07 etc.
